name: palette
title: Palette review
description: Candidate colour systems, each painted on a sample app screen in light and dark, with WCAG contrast measured on the pairs that matter. Pick a favourite, keep or drop the rest, comment on a token, and set a new value for one.
use_when: You proposed colour palettes or design tokens for a product (light and dark themes) and need a person to pick one, shortlist or drop the rest, and say what to change in individual tokens, down to a new value.

shortcuts.does: Show light and dark, light only, or dark only
Show the sample with or without your new values
Keep this palette on the shortlist
